les: Lank voor Mapungubwe was hier al nedersettings
kaps_punt: Veranderinge in die samelewing in die Limpopo-vallei tussen 900 nC en 1 300 nC: groter, meer georganiseerd en meer kompleks - 1 uur. En: Nedersettings in die Limpopo-vallei voor Mapungubwe: K2 en Schroda - 1 uur

items.bewering: Daar loop die Limpopo-rivier, en dit vorm 'n deel van ons land se grens. Aan die ander kant van die rivier lê die lande Zimbabwe en Botswana. Al drie hierdie lande raak vandag juis op hierdie plek aan mekaar.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021, 'New AMS dates for the Middle Iron Age in the Mapungubwe landscape', S Afr J Sci 117(3/4), Fig. 1 (map: Limpopo as border, Zimbabwe and Botswana across it, Shashe-Limpopo confluence); SAHO 'Mapungubwe' (sahistory.org.za/article/mapungubwe): site 'on the border between South Africa, Zimbabwe and Botswana'.

items.bewering: Die Limpopo-vallei is die lae land aan weerskante van die groot rivier.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS), Fig. 1 and text: sites on both the South African and Zimbabwean/Botswana sides of the Shashe-Limpopo basin; a valley is the low ground along a river. Simple but accurate.

items.bewering: Mense het hier gewoon lank voordat Mapungubwe 'n koninkryk geword het.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): Zhizo farmers moved into the Limpopo Valley c. AD 900; Mapungubwe developed c. AD 1200 - roughly three centuries later.

items.bewering: Op baie plekke in die vallei het groepe mense saam in nedersettings gewoon.
items.blok: Al hoe meer mense in die vallei
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): over 500 Middle Iron Age sites (AD 900-1320) documented in the Limpopo Valley.

items.bewering: Tussen 900 nC en 1 300 nC het al hoe meer mense in die hele vallei gewoon. Die getal mense in die vallei het dus groter geword.
items.blok: Al hoe meer mense in die vallei
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS), 'Population dynamics' and Table 2: estimated valley population Zhizo c. 850, K2 c. 4 050, Mapungubwe phase over 10 000 ('As the state grew, so did populations'). Wikipedia 'Kingdom of Mapungubwe': 'The population expanded'.

items.bewering: In 'n nedersetting het leiers besluite vir almal daar geneem. Die werk is ook tussen die mense daar verdeel.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Kingdom of Mapungubwe' (K2 kraals each under a headman, the largest under a chief; women worked copper, men iron); Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): hereditary leadership at K2.

items.bewering: Navorsers verskil oor hoe die gesag in die vallei gewerk het.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS) argue their reading of ethnic stratification 'contra some interpretations'; Wikipedia 'Kingdom of Mapungubwe': some scholars see Zhizo/Leopard's Kopje relations as hostile, others as more complex socially and politically.

items.bewering: In hierdie jare het nedersettings onder 'n middelpunt buite hulleself begin val. So het die manier waarop besluite geneem is, meer georganiseerd geword.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): capitals at Schroda, K2 and Mapungubwe; Leokwe settlements 'under the political authority of K2'; change from a ranked society at K2 to a class-based society with centralised authority at Mapungubwe. Wikipedia 'Kingdom of Mapungubwe': settlement hierarchy of headmen, chiefs and king.

items.bewering: Binne een nedersetting het mense verskillende soorte werk gedoen. Party het graan verbou, en ander het na die beeste omgesien. Party het potte van klei gemaak, en ander het yster tot gereedskap verwerk. 'n Paar mense het die nedersetting gelei.
items.blok: Verskillende werk en dalk 'n nuwe manier van boer
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): sorghum and millet cultivation, grain-bin foundations around a central cattle kraal, ceramic facies (pottery); Wikipedia 'Kingdom of Mapungubwe': 'men worked iron'; SAHO 'Mapungubwe': iron artefacts and pottery recovered.

items.bewering: Later het ander mense van buite die vallei hier kom bly.
items.blok: Verskillende werk en dalk 'n nuwe manier van boer
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): 'At about AD 1000, or slightly later, Leopard's Kopje people established their capital at the site K2'; Wikipedia 'Kingdom of Mapungubwe': Leopard's Kopje people 'moved south to settle Bambandyanalo (K2)'. (The earlier Zhizo also came from outside, from southwest Zimbabwe c. AD 900, which 'ander' does not contradict.)

items.bewering: Volgens party argeoloë het hulle die vloedvlakte langs die rivier begin bewerk, en so het die manier van boer meer kompleks geword, maar dit is nog nie bewys nie.
items.blok: Verskillende werk en dalk 'n nuwe manier van boer
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): 'In contrast to the earlier Zhizo phase, Leopard's Kopje people began to cultivate the margins of the large vlei there', and 'Models of vlei and riverbed cultivation in Zimbabwe suggest...' - the claim is an interpretation resting on site location and analogy models, so the hedge ('party argeoloë', 'nog nie bewys nie') is a fair representation. Wikipedia 'Kingdom of Mapungubwe' describes Limpopo floodplain farming. 'Hulle' correctly refers to the newcomers (K2 people).

items.bewering: Argeoloë ken baie nedersettings in die vallei uit die tyd voor Mapungubwe. Twee daarvan was groot middelpunte.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): hundreds of Middle Iron Age sites; Schroda and K2 named as capitals before Mapungubwe ('the capitals (Schroda, K2 and Mapungubwe)').

items.bewering: Die oudste van die drie plekke in hierdie les is 'n nedersetting wat ons Schroda noem.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS), Fig. 2 and Table 2: Zhizo (Schroda) AD 900-1000, K2 AD 1000-1150, Mapungubwe AD 1270-1320. Bounded to 'van die drie plekke in hierdie les', so the superlative holds.

items.bewering: By Schroda het argeoloë baie beeldjies van klei gevind, onder meer van diere en mense.
items.bron: Nordic Journal of African Studies 27(2), 2018 (njas.fi/njas/article/view/334), citing van Schalkwyk & Hanisch 2002, 'Sculptured in Clay': 'an unusually large cache of clay figurines' at Schroda representing humans and animals.

items.bewering: Ná 'n lang tyd was Schroda nie meer die vallei se middelpunt nie.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS), Table 2: the Zhizo capital phase lasted about 100 years (AD 900-1000); Antonites 2018, 'A revised chronology for the Zhizo and Leokwe horizons at Schroda' (Southern African Humanities): Schroda prominent in the 900s, influence declined by AD 1000. 'Lang tyd' is vague but not false for about a century.

items.bewering: Omtrent dieselfde tyd het ander mense van buite die vallei 'n nedersetting gestig wat ons K2 noem.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): Leopard's Kopje people established K2 at about AD 1000, as Zhizo influence ended; Antonites 2018 links K2's establishment to Schroda's decline.

items.bewering: Party mense wat al in die vallei gewoon het, het weggetrek. Dié wat nie weggetrek het nie, het mettertyd deel van een ander groep geword.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS), 'Ethnic interaction': 'When K2 people took over the valley, many Zhizo people went west to Botswana... Some Zhizo people, however, stayed behind to live within the K2 interaction sphere' (Leokwe); Leokwe kept their own material culture 'for several decades', and 'a national identity appears to have replaced ethnic differences by the early-13th century'. 'Mettertyd' matches the gradual process described.

items.bewering: By K2 het argeoloë baie krale van glas gevind.
items.bron: University of Pretoria repository, Tournié, Prinsloo & Colomban, 'Raman classification of the glass beads excavated on Mapungubwe Hill and K2' (repository.up.ac.za/handle/2263/32069): glass beads from K2, with evidence of glass reworking there; Wikipedia 'Kingdom of Mapungubwe': K2 produced glass roller beads and 'a large number of glass beads were imported'.

items.bewering: Later het die middelpunt van die hele vallei net 'n entjie verder na Mapungubwe geskuif.
items.bron: University of Pretoria repository, Mapungubwe Collection, 'Western peripheral settlement area K2 site' (repository.up.ac.za/handle/2263/1020): K2 lies about 1 km from Mapungubwe; Huffman & Woodborne 2021: capital moved from K2 to Mapungubwe.

items.bewering: Niemand in die vallei het hierdie storie ooit op papier geskryf nie. Byna alles wat ons van hierdie mense weet, kom daarom uit die grond self.
items.bron: World History Encyclopedia, 'Mapungubwe' (worldhistory.org/Mapungubwe): 'the Mapungubwe people left no written record'; history 'must be pieced together from archaeological finds'. 'Byna' correctly leaves room for oral tradition.

items.bewering: Argeoloë grawe op die plekke waar die ou nedersettings gestaan het. Hulle grawe laag vir laag en hou noukeurig boek van wat waar lê.
items.bron: Michigan State University Campus Archaeology Program, 'Archaeology 101: Reading Stratigraphy' (campusarch.msu.edu/?p=334): excavation by layer with recording of each context.

items.bewering: Binne een nedersetting lê die ouer oorblyfsels die diepste.
items.bron: Law of superposition (Steno, 1669), as applied in archaeology - MSU Campus Archaeology, 'Reading Stratigraphy': in undisturbed deposits the oldest layers lie lowest. Holds as a general rule; disturbance (pits, burrows) can be an exception, which is beyond Grade 6 and does not make the statement false.

items.bewering: Argeoloë bepaal ook hoe oud die dinge self is.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): fifteen new AMS radiocarbon dates from 11 Middle Iron Age sites in the Mapungubwe landscape.

items.bewering: Hulle vergelyk die potte van die een plek met dié van die ander. So weet ons watter van die drie plekke die eerste was.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): 'Stratigraphic relationships for this period have helped to produce a definitive ceramic sequence: Zhizo, Leokwe, K2, Transitional K2 and Mapungubwe' - pottery comparison establishes Schroda (Zhizo) as first of the three.

items.bewering: Mense in die streek het geweet waar Mapungubwe lê, en hulle het oorvertel dat dit 'n heilige plek is.
items.bron: University of Pretoria news, 'New book on Mapungubwe Archive contests history...' (up.ac.za/research-matters): 'indigenous knowledge of Mapungubwe Hill as a sacred site by local communities'; SAHO and SANParks: a local man (Mowena) reluctantly showed the 1932 party the path up; Wikipedia 'Kingdom of Mapungubwe': locals 'considered the site sacred'.

items.bewering: Eers Schroda, toe K2 en daarna Mapungubwe.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS), Fig. 2 ceramic sequence and Table 2.

items.bewering: Hierdie drie middelpunte val binne die tyd van 900 nC tot 1 300 nC.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Kingdom of Mapungubwe' and SAHO 'Mapungubwe': Schroda from c. 900, Mapungubwe flourished to around 1300 and was then abandoned. Note for a person, not a fault: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS) now place Mapungubwe's abandonment at about AD 1320, and one older radiocarbon result puts Zhizo at Schroda a little before 900; the 900-1300 frame is the conventional round span and the one CAPS uses, so the statement stands as written.

items.bewering: Al drie lê in dieselfde vallei langs dieselfde rivier.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS), Fig. 1: Schroda, K2 and Mapungubwe all on the south bank of the Limpopo near the Shashe confluence; NJAS 2018: Schroda 'adjacent to the confluence of the Limpopo and the Shashe rivers'.

items.bewering: In hierdie jare het mense van buite die vallei hier kom bly, en party van die vallei se mense het weggetrek.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): Leopard's Kopje people arrived c. AD 1000; many Zhizo went west to Botswana (Toutswe).

items.bewering: Onder die dinge wat verander het, is die getal mense, die gesag en dalk die manier van boer, soos party argeoloë dink.
items.bron: Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): population growth (Table 2), change from ranked to class-based society with centralised authority, and vlei-margin cultivation by Leopard's Kopje people (interpretation, correctly hedged).

items.bewering: Daar is deur al hierdie jare in die vallei geboer en beeste aangehou.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Schroda, South Africa' and NJAS 2018: Zhizo at Schroda a farming and cattle-keeping community; Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (SAJS): K2 and later homesteads with grain bins around cattle kraals; Leokwe herded cattle for K2 elite.

items.bewering: 'n Nedersetting is 'n plek waar 'n groep mense saam woon.
items.bron: Standard definition of settlement (a place where people live together); consistent with usage in Huffman & Woodborne 2021 (homesteads, villages, capitals).

items.bewering: 'n Argeoloog ondersoek die dinge wat mense lank gelede gemaak, gebruik en agtergelaat het om te leer hoe hulle geleef het, en grawe is een van die maniere om daardie dinge te vind.
items.bron: MSU Campus Archaeology, 'Reading Stratigraphy' (archaeology studies the material remains of past people; excavation is one method - surveys such as the Mapungubwe foot surveys in Huffman & Woodborne 2021 are another, so 'een van die maniere' is accurate).

items.bewering: 'n Samelewing is al die mense wat saam leef en met mekaar te doen het.
items.bron: Standard definition of society (people living together in an organised community and interacting); accurate at this level.

items.bewering: Georganiseerd beteken dat dinge gereël is en elke deel sy plek het.
items.bron: Standard dictionary sense of 'organised' (arranged in an orderly, structured way); accurate.

items.bewering: Oorblyfsels is dit wat van iets oorbly nadat die res weg of vergaan is.
items.bron: Standard dictionary sense of 'remains'; accurate.

items.bewering: Die middelpunt van iets is die plek, mens of saak waarom alles draai.
items.bron: Standard figurative sense of 'centre / focal point'; 'waarom alles draai' is an idiom, not a physical claim, and maps correctly onto a capital as a centre of power.

items.bewering: 'n Vloedvlakte is die plat land wat langs 'n rivier lê en onder water kom as die rivier oorloop.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, 'flood plain' (education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/flood-plain): generally flat land next to a river or stream that floods when the river overflows.

items.bewering: nC staan vir 'ná Christus'. Ons kalender tel die jare vanaf ongeveer die tyd toe Jesus Christus gebore is.
items.bron: obliquity.com 'A Brief History of the Calendar' and ABC News 2012 (Pope Benedict XVI): Dionysius Exiguus' Anno Domini count; the actual birth probably a few years earlier (c. 6-4 BC), so 'ongeveer' is correct and necessary.

opsomming: Every checkable claim in this lesson is supported, most of it by Huffman and Woodborne's 2021 peer-reviewed dating study of the Mapungubwe landscape; the superlatives (Schroda oldest, first of the three, older remains deepest) are bounded and correct, the floodplain-farming claim is rightly hedged as an interpretation, the lesson contains no analogy needing a mapping check, and the one point a person may want to know is that the newest dating puts Mapungubwe's end at about 1320 rather than 1300, which does not make the CAPS-framed '900 tot 1 300' statement false.
